name: Step 4 — Safety Valve (SVIX) [EXPERIMENTAL]
description: EXPERIMENTAL -- NOT CONFIRMED BY THE CLIENT. Ravi mentioned "two short strategies" once but only ever discussed SPXU in specific detail; SVIX and every threshold here are IFA's own proposal, never reviewed by Ravi. Concept: while Step 2 is in CASH, ease into SVIX (a bet that volatility falls) once VIX is between 30-40 and curving down, escalate if VIX spikes to 50+, exit fully once VIX drops below 20. This must not be presented as something the client asked for -- it needs his explicit confirmation before it means anything.
